RFQ Details Prairie Advanced Nanomaterials Inc is seeking reliable suppliers of yellow grease and used cooking oil for ongoing procurement. We require consistent volume with full documentation and certifications. Accepted oil types: soybean, canola, sunflower, corn, blended vegetable frying oil, and animal fat or tallow blends up to thirty percent. No motor oil, mineral oil, or industrial lubricants. Quality specifications: free fatty acid content under fifteen percent preferred, maximum twenty-five percent. Moisture and impurities under one percent. Iodine value between eighty and one hundred forty. No excessive polymerization or gumming. Oil must be fresh, non-rancid, and free of food debris, plastic, or metal contamination. Certifications required: supplier must provide certificate of analysis per batch or per load. Food-grade handling documentation preferred. Proof of proper collection, storage, and transportation in food-safe or approved containers. Compliance with Canadian environmental and waste-handling regulations. Delivery: Alberta, Canada. Calgary or Edmonton area preferred. Bulk totes, drums, or tanker loads. Continuous or recurring supply contracts preferred over one-time sales. Contact: Prairie Advanced Nanomaterials Inc.
